sourceAttempts.result: The guide lists Carmichael's Bridge / Heritage Trust at river mile 6 and Huggins Bridge at river mile 0, a six-mile route. It states normal water is 3–7 ft and the river may be traveled between 2–9 ft at Galivants Ferry gauge 02135000.
Direct 00065 stage telemetry is available from Galivants Ferry station 02135000. The route uses the guide-linked local stage series and does not transfer the discontinued Dillon record.
Current access records list Carmichael's Bridge / Heritage Trust and S-41/Huggins Bridge Landing as Active/Open. The former is a limited drop-in; Huggins is county dirt parking.

The scoped trace follows the named channel and both endpoints sit on mapped waterbody. The Carmichael's point is 364 ft from the nearest NHD centerline because the broad floodplain/waterbody geometry is not the access bank; this is retained as a review-level offset with no endpoint relocation claimed.
